Firefox and WebKit cover the named desktop automation cases, not physical mobile devices or every browser version. Native evidence binds its own candidate, viewport and input scope.
Procedural Garden geometry remains subject to final illustrated-art acceptance. The 52 original art files and 460 protected inputs are unchanged.
The earlier G8-V01 boat entry defect is retained with its subsequent visual-resolution receipt. Fixing that defect does not establish final illustrated-art acceptance.

Every result keeps its actual candidate; the whole inventory was not rerun on the last build.

All edits and artifacts remain local. No deployment, public publication, submission, paid evaluation or child-live activation occurred.
